_about: Human-written definitions for every metric and scoring row on the Client Health dashboard. Thresholds and weights are NOT here: build_docs.py reads them from .claude/skills/client-health-refresh/config.json so the docs can never disagree with what runs. Edit a definition here when a metric's meaning changes; edit config.json (by commit) when a number changes.

rows.label: Median time to decision
rows.definition: How long applicant groups wait for a screening decision.
rows.calculation: Median hours from submission to decision for groups decisioned in the window, computed separately for approved and declined groups; the worse (higher) of the two is scored.

rows.label: Approval rate
rows.definition: Share of decisioned groups that were approved.
rows.calculation: approved / decisioned x 100, groups decisioned in the window.

rows.label: Decision override rate
rows.definition: How often the property manager overrode Findigs' decision.
rows.calculation: decisioned groups with a decision override / decisioned x 100. Not gated for SMB (always Green).

rows.label: QA rate
rows.definition: Share of decisions that needed a manual QA review.
rows.calculation: decisioned groups whose workflow status included QA / decisioned x 100.

rows.label: Support tickets per 100 decisions
rows.definition: How much support load the property manager generates relative to volume.
rows.calculation: property-manager support cases created in the window (Pylon cases; applicant- and guarantor-filed, deleted, and pet tickets excluded) / decisioned groups x 100.
rows.source: Sigma, Support Cases BI (q3) and Groups BI (q1)

rows.label: Tech escalation rate
rows.definition: Share of the property manager's support cases escalated to engineering.
rows.calculation: cases with a tech escalation / property-manager cases x 100 (same population as the ticket ratio).

rows.label: Volume trend
rows.definition: Whether application volume is growing or shrinking.
rows.calculation: (groups submitted in the window - groups submitted in the equal prior window) / prior window x 100.

rows.label: PMS integration depth
rows.definition: Health of the integration with the property manager's PMS (AppFolio, Yardi, etc.).
rows.calculation: Band set from the PMS provider and integration review; a Slack integration-friction signal adds a 'flagged' marker but does not change the band.
rows.source: Account record (set at review) + Slack scan flag

rows.label: Business goals documented
rows.definition: Whether the client's business goals for Findigs are written down.
rows.calculation: No data source exists yet; no account has a value, so the row is skipped in scoring.

rows.label: KPIs defined and tracked
rows.definition: Whether success KPIs are agreed and tracked with the client.
rows.calculation: No data source exists yet; no account has a value, so the row is skipped in scoring.

rows.label: Performance review cadence
rows.definition: Whether Findigs held a business or performance review with the client.
rows.calculation: Green if a Gong call in the window is titled as a business/exec review; Yellow if there were calls but none was a review. Refreshed only for accounts with matched Gong calls; otherwise the prior band carries forward.
rows.source: Gong (call titles), matched to the account by email domain

rows.label: Executive sponsor alignment
rows.definition: Whether Findigs' account team is meeting the client's decision-makers.
rows.calculation: Green if at least one client attendee on a Gong call in the window has an exec-level title; Red if there were calls but no client exec. Findigs employees never count. Refreshed only for accounts with matched Gong calls; otherwise the prior band carries forward.
rows.source: Gong (attendee titles), matched to the account by email domain

rows.label: Meeting / touchpoint cadence
rows.definition: Whether Findigs meets the client as often as the segment calls for.
rows.calculation: Touchpoints logged on the HubSpot company in a 90-day window versus the segment's expected cadence.
rows.source: HubSpot meetings and calls (one-time pull, 2026-05-20 to 2026-08-18)

rows.label: Multi-threaded relationship
rows.definition: Whether Findigs has relationships with several people at the client, not one.
rows.calculation: Distinct client contacts on HubSpot meetings and calls in the same window as touchpoint cadence.
rows.source: HubSpot meetings and calls (one-time pull, 2026-05-20 to 2026-08-18)

rows.label: CSM churn-risk flag
rows.definition: The account manager's own read of churn risk.
rows.calculation: The Churn Risk value (Green / Yellow / Red / Churned) on the account. Red forces the overall band to Red. For Full-Screen accounts it is the whole score.
rows.source: Salesforce churn-risk field via Sigma (Companies BI) / HubSpot churn_risk__c

rows.label: Client communication sentiment
rows.definition: How the client sounds in recent communication.
rows.calculation: The account's Slack #p- channel and Gong call summaries in the window, each classified Positive / Neutral / Negative (Green / Yellow / Red); the more negative of the two wins. Cleared (unscored) when there is no fresh Slack or Gong data.

rows.label: Support ticket friction
rows.definition: Whether the client has open, unresolved support friction.
rows.calculation: Open property-manager friction tickets created in the window (pet and applicant tickets excluded): 0 = Green, 1-2 = Yellow, 3 or more = Red. Every Red is re-checked against Pylon by an independent reviewer.

rows.label: NPS
rows.calculation: No NPS data has ever existed; the row is skipped in scoring.

context.label: Revenue by quarter
context.definition: Findigs revenue from the account for each quarter of the year; QoQ compares the last two complete quarters.

context.label: Revenue month over month
context.definition: Revenue change between two complete calendar months.

context.label: Median underwriting decision time
context.definition: Median underwriting hours across decisioned groups.

context.label: Live units (this month)
context.definition: Units live on Findigs this month, summed across the account's child companies; cross-checked against Unit Counts BI every run.
context.source: Sigma, Companies BI (q4), checked by Unit Counts BI (gate 6)

context.label: Units sold (booked)
context.definition: Cumulative booked units, New Logo + Expansion (booked, not live).

context.label: Live vs sold
context.definition: Live units / units sold x 100: how much of what was sold is actually live.

context.label: Application completion rate
context.definition: Applicants who submitted / applicants who started, for people whose first event is in the window (also shows completed applications and funnel total).

context.label: Groups submitted vs expected
context.definition: Actual groups submitted vs a derived 'expected' benchmark (no real target exists in any system; provisional).

context.label: Account manager / CSA
context.source: owner_map.json (from the CS Health Score workbook), not HubSpot csm_owner

context.label: Prior band, weeks red, band history
context.definition: Last run's band, consecutive weeks Red, and every run's band for the trend chart.
